clues: This port city sits on Algoa Bay on the south east coast of South Africa. It faces the Indian Ocean.
This city lies between a land of winter rain to the west and a land of summer rain to the east. Its year stays even, with harsh heat and deep cold both rare.
A man named Sir Rufane Donkin set this town up in the year 1820. He was the head of the Cape lands at that time.
This port is a start point for trips to see the big five wild beasts of Africa. Such trips are a top draw for guests.
In the year 2021, this city was given a new name in law. It came from the old name for the river that flows through town.
